messages:
maria: Heads-up — thinking about adding a "Projected Cost Impact" card to the routing page. When ops toggles "prefer-cheaper-variant" we should show delta in token spend and expected latency tradeoff. Anyone see obvious telemetry gaps?

jonathan: +1. We need per-invocation model_sku and cache_hit flag in telemetry. Current trace has model and duration but cache hits are aggregate. Also sampling at 0.1 hides tail.

ashok: Is this UI for canary only or full rollouts? For canary we already have per-canary metrics baked but not cost sims.

sophie: Devex: We might also expose an internal API endpoint `/v1/internal/cost_preview` that accepts routing slices + volume distro and returns token_cost_delta. Minimal surface: POST {route, pct, target_model}. Could be used by UI and CLI.

jonathan: Telemetry notes: add fields: model_sku, effective_sequence_len, cache_tier (none/prefix/kv), cache_hit bool, path_id. Sample payload snippet:

```json
{"route":"chat.prod.search","model":"redwood-medium-v1","seq_len":240,"cache_tier":"kv","cache_hit":false,"tokens_generated":60}
```

maria: Nice. How do we compute amortized cache savings? We need to attribute prefetch credit vs on-demand hits.

sophie: Suggest metric names: token_cost, infra_cost_est, cache_credit_applied. Also need to surface unit_econ per 1k tokens.

jonathan: On sampling: we can keep full payload for 1% of requests, aggregated histograms for rest. But cost_preview needs deterministic outputs even when sample misses. So associate sampling_key (trace_id) so preview can simulate using historical heuristics.

ashok: Rollout UX: preview should accept "canary 5% -> cheaper variant" and show confidence interval. We can reuse existing canary simulator in eng-releases.

maria: ok. API + telemetry changes approved in principle. Action items?

devex-bot: New ticket created: INF-4123 "cost-preview API + telemetry fields" — assignees: @jonathan @sophie @ashok

jonathan: I'll add telemetry PR with schema + migration. Quick SQL for cost per-route:

```sql
SELECT route, model_sku, sum(tokens_generated) as tokens, sum(tokens_generated * model_price_per_token) as cost
FROM events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route, model_sku;
```

linda: Heads-up: pricing table uses dynamic pricing tiers per SKU — need to pin to snapshot at time of invocation for accurate invoicing.

maria: Good call. Add price_snapshot_id to telemetry.

jonathan: Also cache_credit bookkeeping: we must emit prefetch_id when credit consumed.

sophie: UX mock idea — slider to change percent rollout -> live cost delta and 95% CI. I can sketch.

maria: Perfect. Can we commit to a timeline? Suggest telemetry schema PR by Friday, API prototype early next week, UI mock before next demo.

ashok: Works for releases — aim for canary end-to-end in 2 sprints.

jonathan: Will post PR and link here: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/834 (CI pending)

maria: Thanks. If nobody objects, I'll schedule sync Friday 10am.

linda: no objections. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: Meeting added to calendar: "Cost Preview sync" Fri 10:00 — invite: #eng-platform, @jonathan, @sophie, @ashok, @linda
